reviews.text: Great service from Jalon
Loved this place & so did my girl Roxie , they did a amazing job on her , very nice staff , we will 100% come back!

I was overjoyed to find this salon for our two senior pups!  I was even more blessed to find Jalon 💝 He understood right away the needs and expectations the pups had, especially our big guy with a delicate condition.  Jalon showed both dogs extra love and kindness that went above and beyond.  I have found the home for our  sweet babies to be pampered and made beautiful at Kennedy's ... thank you Jalon ♥️🐾 🐾

The service here is priceless, Everybody is professional,  kind and real. The Grooming is great. I had  to go out town on vacation, my baby was taken of so good.  Jason sent pictures to let me see how she was doing .I recommend them to everyone. The  grooming and boarding great service.
Kuda did the best job with my 3 dogs. Not going to take them anywhere else. I am very pleased with the services and recommend you bring your dogs here.

Before our trip, we unexpectedly had to find a new groomer and pet sitter for our two Yorkies at the last minute. After a previous bad experience elsewhere, I was understandably nervous. However, from the moment I reached out to Kennedy’s Pet Service and spoke to Jalon I knew my fur babies would be in great care.
They were professional, kind, and genuinely cared about our dogs. Both of our pups came home looking great  after their grooming, and it was clear they had been well cared for during their stay. We received great communication throughout the process, which gave us so much peace of mind while we were away.
Finding a place you can truly trust with your pets isn’t easy, but we’re so grateful we found Kennedy’s Pet Services.

I’ve been bringing my daughter Paris she’s a Pomeranian to get groomed here and when I tell you that the staff is so friendly and professional and they do walk ins which made me happy the prices are very fair. My pup after being groomed smells so good and looks very nice after her cut. I definitely recommend you all to bring your pets here to be spoiled.
Bad behavior. Do not recommend
NOT RECOMMENDED!!! They cut my dog ​​and didn't say a word; we only noticed when we got home. I went back with the police, but they were arrogant and never admitted that an accident had occurred.
Great customer service every single time we visit. Super understanding and will treat your dog with the highest respect. Small mom and pop shop as well so plz support them !!!

Shantel works on Sunday’s and this was her second time grooming my Buttons.  She did a GREAT JOB!!! We were taking Buttons to a well known chain groomer and they would butcher our baby.  Shantel is skilled in what she does.  Thank you Shauntel for your expertise service and for taking care of our Buttons baby.

Took my baby Harley in for a bath after getting sprayed by a skunk and she got 3 baths, a condition, and her nails trimmed for under $70!! Love this place and Jalon was amazing with her! I highly recommend ask for him!
They do such a great job!
They are THE BEST!!  Will never take my dogs anywhere else!

I had such an amazing experience bringing my dog to Kennedy Pet Services! From the moment we walked in, Shantel made us feel completely comfortable and cared for. She handled my dog with so much patience, love, and attention—it truly showed how passionate she is about what she does.

Everything I requested, she delivered at a top-tier level. She really took the time to listen and made sure every detail was exactly how I wanted it. My dog can be a little anxious, but Shantel stayed calm, gentle, and reassuring the entire time, which meant so much to me.

The grooming results were outstanding—my dog looked and felt incredible! You can tell she takes pride in her work and goes above and beyond for her clients. I will absolutely be a forever client. Highly recommend Kennedy Pet Services to anyone looking for quality care and exceptional service!

I love Kennedy’s Cypress  Rd They do an amazing job. Shantel  Does amazing cuts with the dogs  if you look for somewhere to bring your cat that has experience and patience I recommend you take them here. They do a really, really great job.

Shantel was amazing with my pup, the salon was clean and well kept as well. I’m originally from Florida and came in town to visit a friend. The people were so friendly and took their time on my Charlie. Detail and quality takes time. I’m so very proud I took my fur baby here and got to experience excellent service. This where I will go whenever I’m in town.
I had Shantel do my services, Omg wow she literally was the best! Very professional, very knowledgeable!

Five stars for Shantel! She is hands-down the best dog groomer we’ve ever used. I take my Chihuahua to her regularly, and the results are consistently perfect. Shantel has a wonderful way with dogs. My puppy always comes back looking refreshed and happy, never stressed out.
​Shantel’s talent really shines through. It’s clear she loves what she does, and it shows in how great my pup looks every time she leaves the salon. If you are looking for a reliable, skilled, and gentle groomer, look no further!

I recently moved to the area and was in need of a good groomer, so I decided to give this location a try. From the moment I walked in, I was warmly greeted by Shantel, who assisted me with check-in and explained the grooming packages.
I have a Yorkie, and I’m very particular about how I like his cut, but she reassured me that their services are very pet-friendly and that my baby would come out looking beautiful and she was absolutely right!
The salon is clean, fresh, and welcoming, and the staff is incredibly friendly. What I really appreciated is that they take their time with each dog. Grooming is not rushed here they truly focus on detail and quality, and it shows in their work.
Their prices are reasonable, and you can tell they are genuinely passionate about what they do. In my opinion, this is one of the best grooming salons in Houston. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I brought my dog in for a regular grooming appt. His appt was for 10:30am they didn’t get started with him until 12:30. They had him in a kennel for two hours. They finally got done with him at 2pm I picked him up by 3 and the lady complained about him peeing all over the kennel. They sent him home with me after I paid 85 dollars for a small dog with pee all over his paws. I have been here 4 times before and grooming only took an hour meanwhile this lady argued with me about it never t taking an hour when I have appt times and pick up notifications in my phone. Veryyy unprofessional place. Never again.

Amazing experience with Jalon. He was communicative, on time and went the extra mile to help me by picking up and dropping off my dog due to logistics issue I had. Very happy with the grooming service and will be a repeat customer hereonout!
Great Place! Great Service! Great Grooming! Great Prices! Thank You Very Much JG.

Called and took my dog right away because they had availability. He was done with his bath and nail trim in an hour. Great service, great customer service, and great prices. Jalon did a great job and even did a deshedding treatment for my dog. 10/10 recommend.

I think I've left a review of this business before but I want to say it again. THEY ARE THE BEST! I have two pitbulls. Honey is my younger one and has to get her nails trimmed once a month. Most of the time Dylan does them but whoever does them, they always do a great job. Today I wanted to take my older pitbull, Koda, to get his nails trimmed but he's very reactive to other dogs. I asked if I could come at the end of the day when all the other dogs were gone. Even though they were past their close time, and on a Friday, they called me and told me to come and they took care of Koda. I appreciate Jalon and the team at Kennedy’s so much and I'm very lucky they are only a few blocks from my home. I will always recommend Kennedy’s to anyone looking for a groomer.

Thank you so much, Jalon and Kalli!

You both have been incredibly professional, kind, and attentive. My fur babies—Doc, Ginger, and Larry—were so well taken care of, and that means everything to me. We’re truly excited to be part of the family.

Much love, and God bless!

The establishment is very clean and professional. Mary took her time and provided superb service. Chocolate looked amazing. The entire professional staff including the gentleman that answers the phone and greets you, were all ALL topnotch.  Nice job KPS- Cypresswood.
Excellent service. Friendly and profession. I have been taking my boxer to get “The Works” package for years.

I literally was in the parking lot when they offered to hook my dog up on the spot. Perfect timing. Bella was a happy camper, she's normally scared of the groomers. I love that they're literally down the road from me.

They did nothing I told them to do. Please don’t book with this woman she very unprofessional.  after I did the review she’s calling my phone harassing me from a “No caller ID” number this is very scary . I will have to press charges or sue her this is not how you run a business!! The place is very ghetto Dogs looks very sad 💔 please don’t waste your time or money here

I understand the owners are from New Orleans but in Texas we don’t play !

I brought my dog Aubree in for a grooming appointment and we had such a great experience! Her haircut came out perfect — super clean, adorable, and exactly what I asked for. They were also really fast without rushing or cutting corners, which I really appreciated. The staff was so friendly and professional from start to finish.

Highly recommend Jalon and Shantell — they were amazing with Aubree and made the whole visit comfortable and smooth. We’ll definitely be coming back!

This was the best experience I have ever had with any pet groomer. Kennedy's Pet Services really made my experience smooth and very easy to book. After multiple groomer either over booked or flat out told me they couldnt take in all 3 of my babies. It was a last minute booking, due to my work schedule and it being christmas eve the next day I couldnt find a groomer that could take in all 3 of my fur babies. I reached out to Kennedy's Pet Services in hope they would be able to and without hesitation Jalon said "I got you bring them babies in!" and boy did they deliver and got all 3 of them all in time for Christmas. If I could give them a 10 star review I would. Alfred ,Aggie and Magenta are clean, deshedded ,smelling good and with all fresh mani and pedi's right in time for Christmas. Thank you once again to the staff at Kennedy's Pet Service and special thank you to Jalon and the young lady that stayed late with him for getting our babies ready for the holidays.
Took both my cat and dog here in the same day. They had great professionalism and quick, clean service. Highly recommend

Shantell ! Your amazing ! I loved the whole experience from drop off to pick up. The entire crew is thorough! Shantell your attention to detail is unmatched and I love she gave at home pointers ! They are quick as well ! Run don’t walk to book your appt for your fur baby! Hustle says thank you !
I’m a new customer and Kalli took such good care of my girl Luna. She came out so cute and clean and I will continue to bring my girl here from now on!
The service done on my dogs was great..I definitely found a gym
They did an amazing job, and my Drako came out super happy. Excellent service, with great dedication and so much love for our little fur babies. Definitely coming back!

I can’t say enough good things about KPS. They cared for my dog well. The groomers are true professionals from the attention to detail and the overall care shown to Carti is unmatched. Very great place.

I took my dog ​​to get groomed and they ruined her. They did a terrible job, leaving her with all sorts of uneven cuts. The grooming was a complete disaster, and the price was outrageous for the mess they made. I will never take her to this place again.
Great experience! They got us in with short notice for a nail grind. Staff was friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. We will definitely be back for additional grooming sessions.
Just had my dog Leo groomed today. Excellent service and work done. Everyone was friendly and they took great care of him. Leo looks GREAT! I give them my highest recommendation!

cheapest place ive found in my area! my puppy Killer could feel the good vibes and just walked right in! haha loved the haircut and service. it was exactly what i wanted , def recommending all my dog mamas n daddys to come here <33

I have been coming here around a year, Seth , Dylan and the whole team are friendly and are great at cutting my frenchie and shitzus hair. They are great with appointments , always on time and are open all week. They are always busy and you can tell they truly love the animals they tend to. The inside of the store also has a good smell too it and great atmosphere. I would recommend this pet service store to anyone who wants to get their pets groomed. They will treat your pets as their own. This is a great pet groomers store in the northwest part of town.
Dylan worked on Ace and did a perfect job. Exactly how we asked and quick job too
Got turned down by Petco.  Shantell did an amazing job.  Will definitely be back going forward

Took my bernedoodle in, came out looking like a
Poodle! Not happy- it will take months for her to grow back out

You know that feeling when you're out of town, your furry best friend's nails are looking like miniature daggers, and you're just hoping to find a place that does more than a quick snip? Yeah, that was me. And let me tell you, what I found was pure gold.
A Paw-some First Impression
My quest for a nail grinding service for my pit/terrier/boxer mix, Rocket, began with a few "ick, no thanks" phone calls to other businesses. But then I called Jalon's Pet Palace (or whatever awesome name they go by!), and yo, the guy who answered was an absolute breath of fresh air. Personable, friendly, and genuinely eager for our business – it was the exact opposite of those off-putting encounters. Even though it meant a complete U-turn in the opposite direction of our next adventure, something in his voice told me it would be worth it. And boy, was it!
Master of the Mastiff (and More!)
We pulled up to find Jalon finishing up with a majestic Bull Mastiff. And here's the kicker: the Mastiff looked happy and totally at ease. This was a huge green flag for me, signaling that Jalon clearly has a way with all breeds, big or small. My worry about Rocket's, shall we say, enthusiastic nature quickly evaporated.
Rocket's Red Glare (and a Shiny Smile!)
We went in for the nail grinding, and then, because I'm a responsible pet parent (and slightly brave), I inquired about anal gland expressing. Jalon, without missing a beat, squeezed Rocket in. No pun intended, but seriously, I still chuckle at the thought!
When we picked Rocket up, he wasn't just wagging his tail; he had a whole new, shiny smile! Turns out, Jalon had brushed his teeth and cleaned his ears too. Wow. Just wow. Rocket was definitely overdue for these extra services, and we didn't even ask for them. Jalon simply anticipated his needs. That, my friends, is next-level service. This guy hooked us up!
The Verdict: Five Stars and a Recommendation!
Absolutely amazing! Five stars all around. Jalon is a true pro, dedicated to making sure your pet leaves feeling (and looking) their absolute best. He's got that perfect blend of serious skill and a lighthearted touch that puts both pets and their humans at ease.
Seriously, if your furry friend needs some pampering, recommend definitely! Tell them your girl sent you and get $5 off your service. Trust me, it's well worth the drive – even if it means a hilarious U-turn!

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PUPPIES HERE!
I took my Pomeranian to get a haircut and they shave him, they know nothing about dogs and their correct treatment, they didn’t even gave me a call to inform me of anything after i Specifically told them that Pomeranians can’t be shaved!!
Please don’t take your puppies here if you really love them

Every person there is so nice and wanted to please me concerning my pet. Callie gave me options and helped me make decisions for my pet. I am a first timer.  My pets hair cut was perfect and well taken care of. The man at the desk is very nice.
Our pup Mighty loved her haircut and so did we!
Very quick and reasonably priced. I will be returning.
Very nice staff, Good pricing. They did a great job with my puppy. I got exactly what i asked for. Definitely recommend!!

My dog loves this place. They are always welcoming and flexible with work schedule.
My Shih Tzu, always leaves looking very handsome and happy. Hugo loves Kennedy’s and we love them too thank you
They were Awsome ! Sky loved it

ive always booked with the big guy with dreads and he always told me 2 to 4 hours and seems like it always took about 4 hours sometimes more. this time another young guy cut my dog and he finished in a hour and with the same great quality haircut! i was SHOCKED! definitely book your dogs here they all do a great job!

I’ve been coming to KPS for about two years now and have always been 100% satisfied! Kevron has consistently done an amazing job grooming my Scrappy Doo—he’s the reason I keep coming back. However, this past Saturday Scrappy had a new groomer, Dylan, and unfortunately, the results were disappointing. His cut was patchy and uneven, which was very unlike the quality we’re used to. I called the salon, and Kevron immediately stepped in to fix the issue—no questions asked, just great service as always. Do yourself a favor and book with Kevron. He’s the best, and you’ll leave happy every time!
Friendly and professional team. They do such a good job with my cat's bath and lioncut. They actually get her to purr during the haircut!
Dylan did an amazing job! My dog walked out looking and smelling great!
Did a great job trimming my dog's nails and giving her a bath. She loved it, and she loved Jalon.

NEW FAVORITE GROOMER!  We tried Kennedy Pet Services for our 2 mini poodle mixes because we moved and it's not convenient to travel so far to our old groomer.  We are so glad we did!  We love this place better than our old groom shop.  Shantel and Dylan did an excellent job on the haircuts for each dog and our dogs came out of the experience not anxious or stressed at all like they used to.  They are obviously doing things right here at KPS.  Definitely our new fav regular spot for our boys, AND less expensive than our old spot.  Thanks guys!  You're the best!

Jalon was very nice. Koda got a nice wash and cut, loved his cut. I think they did a wonderful job. If the face looks choppy it’s because my sister tried to trim his face and didn’t do good, but I think they fixed it nicely. Loved going here will definitely be back 😄👍 …

★★★★★ Absolutely the Best Groomers!

I have my son's dog, Stella, while he is away for military training. She’s close to 100 lbs. and has anxiety, but the team at Kennedy's Pet Services always takes the time to make her feel comfortable. My son trusts them completely, and Stella has never been to any other groomer.

Jalen is especially wonderful—patient, detailed, and truly caring. The entire staff is professional, and their communication is outstanding. The appointment reminders and updates on when to pick up Stella make everything so easy.

This is my first time caring for a dog, and they’ve been incredibly helpful with their knowledge and support, while my son is away. I wouldn’t take Stella anywhere else! Highly recommend!

Shantel did an amazing job with my toy poodle, customer service was top tier I felt comfortable leaving Tiny there while I ran a few errands. My baby is not a fan of her paws being touched Shantel was so patient! My baby has never smelled so good finally mat free! We will be back.
These pet groomers are the best! They did a wonderful job on my dog, Coco! She looks great! And most importantly Coco had a good time on her doggy spa day at Kennedy Pet Services!

They did great with my dog’s nail trim, and let me come within an hour of calling. Very kind and considerate. Today was my first time here but my mom has been taking her dog for nail trims for a long time and my roommate also takes her dog here.
Did a phenomenal job… I loved it, Jalen came through, I came in day before and was able to book an appointment for the next day.

I was so nervous about my Schnoodle puppy's haircut since she was super matted, but this groomer did an amazing job! They managed to avoid shaving her all the way down while still giving her a clean haircut. At the end, they even added the cutest little bows to her ears, which I am obsessed with!
I got the Works package. The appointment took around 4-5 hours but the drop-off and pick-up process was super convenient. They called me when she was ready for pick up so I still had flexibility with my day.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a groomer who genuinely cares about your dog and takes the time to do a thoughtful job! I’ll definitely be back!
The staff is very nice and easy going. My yorkie always comes out exactly like i ask.
I recently adopted a doodle mix and her hair was in pretty bad shape. They did a good job getting her cleaned up!
Friendly and quick services!! Thank you!
They were very friendly and accommodating to our schedule. When we picked up our Shih Tzu he was well groomed, clean and looked absolutely adorable! Highly recommend it!

Great customer service 💯🐕‍🦺.
Staff was super friendly 😁
Great 👍 place to bring big dog 🐕 to get a cut or  a 🛁 bath …
Sam did a great job  and can't beat the pricing! Took great care of our pup and made him look good!

Great experience. I needed my dog’s nails trimmed but I was concerned about my dog becoming aggressive. The groomer introduced himself to my dog and my dog found a friend. I usually take my dog to the vet but now my dog has a new friend who takes excellent care of him.
We took our three dogs for a cut bath, nail trim and buffing. They did a great job and very good prices!! We'll definitely be back!
Staff a very friendly and super patient as we descended with all 4 basset hounds at once.   Highly recommend!

I am so incredibly impressed with this grooming salon. I can't even put it into words.

I have 3 medium/large dogs, 2 of whom I have had issues with being nervous and reactive at groomers and vets in the past. My boy is terrified of men, so I was apprehensive bringing him in,  but he ran straight up to Seth and let him walk him back. Everyone there was so incredibly patient with both of my nervous pups.

You made this dog mom's day. 1000000/10 would reccomend.
Did a great job trimming our puppy’s nails. Thanks much for for patience in getting this done!
They always cut my doodle so well!

Seth and his team were absolutely amazing! 10 out 10 ! We will definitely be returning customers. This was my puppy Pepper’s first visit and he took my baby from shabby to chic! Great prices, awesome service and great results!! Thank you!! 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽❤️ …

First time taking Duke here, and it turned out great. He loved it, I loved it 10/10 recommend
!!!
They did an excellent job with my Bichon who had a messed up cut from another groomer. Excellent customer service
Very helpful and patient with the dogs!
Love love! This place is great with dogs, I got my 6 month old German shepherd bathed and he looks brand new ✨
